instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Get the latest posts, videos or episodes of a creator or a topic from their Atom or RSS feed", and give it url (The public address of the feed).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-the-latest-items-of-a-feed and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads one public Atom or RSS feed (at most 2 MB, 15 seconds) and returns its title (source) and its items, each with an item_id (the id the feed gives it, else its link), title, published, url and description.
